PART III - LANDS FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 56 (Mannar) Whereas a settlement notice under Section 4 of the Land Settlement Ordinance was duly published in the Gazette No. 107 of 19th September 1980, and as otherwise required by the said Section, in respect of the lands situated in a Part of the village Called Pandara Illuppeikulam in the Grama Niladhari Division of Iranei Illuppeikulam Now Divisonal Secretary’s Division of Madhu in Regional Revenue Division of Manthei (Then Manthei West) of the Mannar District in the Northern Province and described as lots 66,67, 68, 71 in TOPO Graphical Preliminary Plan No. 45 (North) vide Settlement Notice No. 4945 (Mannar) And whereas all claims received in pursuance of the said notice have been duly dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the said Ordinance: I, the undersigned, in pursuance of the powers conferred on me by Section 5(5) of the said Ordinance do hereby make order that the lands or portions thereof be settled as specified in the Schedule to this order. L.G.P. PRASAD. Assistant Settlement officer Deputy Commissioner of Land Title Settlement (Land) Land Title Settlement Department, Battaramulla, 14th December, 2023
